title: 구독자
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop influenced Pop Rock. Distorted electric guitar plays a syncopated power chord riff. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with bright, staccato picking. The bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with a punchy, mid-forward tone. Drums feature a tight snare and a driving eighth-note hi-hat pattern. Male vocals are delivered in a mid-range tenor with a rhythmic, almost conversational cadence in the verses, transitioning to a more melodic and sustained delivery in the chorus. Key of E Major. Tempo is 135 BPM. Time signature is 4/4.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, drum fill]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals, driving bass and drums]
구독자 수를 확인한다
어제보다 하나가 줄었다
고작 하나인데 가슴 한쪽이 쿵 내려앉는다
누가 나를 떠났을까

[Verse 2]
무엇이 맘에 안 들었을까
콘텐츠를 다시 본다
어디가 문제였을까 뒤적인다
숫자 하나가 사람을 흔든다

[Chorus]
[full band, layered electric guitars]
숫자 하나가 사람을 흔든다
화면 위의 작은 숫자 하나가
오늘의 자존감을 결정한다
나는 숫자가 아닌데
숫자로 [cymbal crash]
